title: HashiCorp Vault or AWS Secrets Manager: Managing Secrets Across Environments
excerpt: Vault is a flexible secrets platform that runs anywhere; AWS Secrets Manager is a fully managed service inside AWS. The trade-off is flexibility against operational simplicity.
verdict: Vault is the stronger and more flexible choice for complex, hybrid or multi-cloud environments, with features such as dynamic, short-lived credentials. Secrets Manager is quicker and simpler if you are fully on AWS and want a managed service with no infrastructure to run.
